verdict.rationale: LegalOS is a SaaS immigration platform that holds users' case materials, so data export and portability is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents intake, evidence organization and attorney review, but has nothing on exporting data, open formats or account offboarding. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
